title: Gate release.sh --no-test behind a printed checklist
action: In scripts/release.sh, add a --confirm flag to the option-parse loop (the `case` at lines 70-84) and, immediately after that loop, gate --no-test behind it per CONTEXT D3. When RUN_TESTS=0 and --confirm was not passed: print a four-item release checklist to stderr. On an interactive run (stderr is a TTY) exit 1 without running anything; with no TTY, print the same checklist lines plus one line saying the skip is proceeding unconfirmed, and continue. Replace the lone `log "warn: --no-test …"` at the old line 269 with a reference to the checklist already printed, so the skip is not announced twice. Update the usage comment at lines 33-36 with the --no-test --confirm spelling. Then add scripts/tests/release-confirm-gate.sh: a kept regression test that drives the real script on all three paths with BEE_DISPATCH_ID unset (so every path refuses at the authorization check at line 101-102 with 'nothing was changed' and no tag, commit or push can occur), using `script -qec` to allocate a pty for the two interactive paths, and asserts: (1) `--no-test` alone on a TTY prints all four checklist items and exits 1 before the authorization check is reached; (2) `--no-test --confirm` on a TTY prints no checklist refusal and reaches the authorization failure; (3) `--no-test` with no TTY prints the checklist and reaches the authorization failure. The test must exit 0 only when all three hold. Finally sync the two places that document the flag: CLAUDE.md's Release section and docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/release-identity-and-version-parity.md.
must_haves: scripts/release.sh accepts --confirm; the usage comment at lines 33-36 gains the --no-test --confirm spelling
On a TTY, `--no-test` without `--confirm` prints a four-item checklist and exits 1 at option-parse time, before the gh and BEE_DISPATCH_ID checks run
With no TTY, `--no-test` prints the same four items and proceeds — the unattended herding release path is not broken (CONTEXT D3)
The old duplicate warn line at the test step no longer announces the skip a second time
scripts/tests/release-confirm-gate.sh exists, is executable, drives the real scripts/release.sh, and exits non-zero if any of the three paths regresses
No path the test drives can tag, commit, push or bump: every one is asserted to stop at or before the authorization refusal
CLAUDE.md and the release-identity knowledge doc both state the new spelling — neither still describes --no-test as warn-only
